2.name: Here We Go Again
2.overview: Disventure Camp is back with a brand new host! Fourteen new contestants are invited to Camp Tipiskaw to win $1,000,000! As their first challenge, the teams will go through a relay race, starting in the water, going to land, land and finishing on... land again.

2.name: Playing with Fire
2.overview: The competition heats up during an overnight challenge, tempers flare on both teams, and one alliance is left in a precarious spot after losing its newest member.

2.name: Wheel of Missfortune
2.overview: The teams are pitted against each other in a game of kiss, compliment, insult, where the contestants' true feelings about each other come to light, then, a shocking twist is announced.

2.name: Truth Hurts
2.overview: A player finds an advantage that twists the game. The teams face their most embarrassing challenge yet. To win, they'll have to admit their most humiliating secrets, presented by the host as "fun" facts — but only fun for her, of course.

2.name: Queen Says
2.overview: The contestants are at Kristal's mercy when she forces them to play a game of "Queen Says" as the challenge, which clearly doesn't go well after getting called out by someone. One contestant decides to turn the soups, taking down and hospitalizing the public enemy.

2.name: Broke & Back Mountain
2.overview: The merge has arrived. The competitors will have to form pairs to navigate the forest of Camp Tipiskaw. Meanwhile, things aren't going well for the host and her intern, and one competitor's journey may come to an end.

2.name: Easier Said Than Done
2.overview: In order to win the first individual immunity challenge, contestants are put in tournament of dodgeball, duels, and ring toss which doesn't go so well with the intern gone. At elimination, one unfortunate contestant becomes the first person booted out from the merge.

2.name: Nightmare at Tipiskaw
2.overview: With the host searching for the former intern, the bus driver and his puppet are in charge. This time, the challenge is to SURVIVE all the way to dawn, with a butcher on the loose that may return to the game.

2.name: Breaking the Ice
2.overview: The today's challenge is snowing as contestants must build a sled which they would have to slide with down a snowy hill, but one contestant suffers a medical emergency.

2.name: Bursting Bubbles
2.overview: As the merge gets more intense, the final five square off in a “pop-the-balloon” challenge, where the last person standing, of course, wins. Things begin the stir up, after one of the biggest betrayals comes into play.

2.name: Rotten Fruit
2.overview: In order to make it to the finale, contestants must jump at a certain level for an advantage, then use fruits as ammunition to hit the target, none other than the puppet to win. At elimination, one contestant makes things change.

2.name: Hanging by a Ledge
2.overview: The finale is here and the finalists must race to the finish line from sky, water, and finally land to drive to the finish line to win $1,000,000! But things go wrong as a contestant hangs by a ledge.

2.name: Money, Fame and Shame
2.overview: As the season comes to a closure, amends are made, problems are solved, $1,000,000 is given out to the winner, and the next season is teased to have familiar faces.

5.name: Total Fanfare
5.overview: Following the events of the previous season, Disventure Camp is back with a new host and its biggest season ever! 12 of the show's biggest superfans will be pitted against 12 of the show's most iconic past competitors for a cash prize of $1,000,000. Who will go home? and who will go down in Disventure Camp history?

5.name: On The Ropes
5.overview: The contestants must work together during a relay challenge, and a twist threatens to shake up the game.

5.name: Volca-No You Don't!
5.overview: Following a mix up in the teams, new alliances and enemies are made. Today's fiery immunity challenge will test the contestants' speed and endurance, as well as their aim.

5.name: Goin' Coconuts
5.overview: A redux of a previous challenge! Today's immunity challenge is easy at first, but becomes exponentially more difficult. Contestants must search the jungle for corn to throw into the opposing team's basket, in an effort to make the weight unbearable and cause it to fall. A third person is voted out, but exposes someone's "advantage" before leaving.

5.name: Pole It Together
5.overview: A new immunity totem has been found, but something is off about it. Another player is accused of having an advantage (even though they don't actually have it) and an actual advantage turns the elimination trial on its head. After one final showdown, one contestant decides to step down from their legacy in hopes of building a better life.

5.name: Carnival Of Chaos
5.overview: Come twice, come double the all, welcome back to the Stawaki Carnival! Listen to these rules and you'll have an unforgettable time, grab the keys at set locations, and use them to unlock the carnival rides. But the number one rule is, do not bully your teammates, or everyone will see your true character, and you will go home without $1,000,000.

5.name: In Full Bloom
5.overview: Emily is getting married! Not really, but this challenge is give her the perfect bouquet using the correct flowers on the list provided. At one camp, somebody gets their revenge for the second time, though possibly at the cost of their alliance.

5.name: Upstage Upset
5.overview: It's everyone's favorite challenge, the musical! Not only will the team with the most points win immunity, but a member of the losing team will also secure immunity for being the best performer on that team. A seventh person goes home after misplaying their hand.

5.name: Line In The Sand
5.overview: Contestants must pull the players off a pole and bring them to the other side. While one contestant finally locks in for once, another one is still not locked in. After one team's loss, a long-standing challenge burden is finally sent home.

5.name: Project Runaway
5.overview: We're heading back to Soluna Idol, this time for a FASHION SHOW! Contestants must take three hours to design one of the contestants on the respective teams. At one camp, one player decides to make a big move by eliminating a close friend.

5.name: Tipiskaw Gone Wild
5.overview: Stawaki Carnival? How about a trip to Camp Tipiskaw instead! The contestants must make their way through the abandoned campgrounds from the first three seasons while avoiding the feral animals that have settled there. A shocking outcome leaves someone on one team heartbroken. While, on the other team, one contestant manipulates the vote to eliminate their own ally.

5.name: How Low Can You Go?
5.overview: With a loss of a good friend, an intense rivalry reaches up to its maxinum, and alliances reach its breaking point. Things also doesn't go easy on the other team as well, with a heartbroken contestant, a close friendship falls apart cause of a simple rejection. Meanwhile, a contestant hides between many conflicts, easily orchestrating a surprising, yet emotional elimination trial.

overview: Several people spend weeks at a rundown camp competing in wild challenges for a million-dollar prize, where alliances, rivalries, friendships, romances, and betrayals take central stage. In the end, only one will claim the grand prize.
title: Disventure Camp
